test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark(?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbcb281993bb1dabe2bdb88a6647e29e32b3d6089f38bafb4d456d434efefbc3.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f5035a449c1d0f59d6d2e3c127d050b4a6393468b2c27e91926c6be2fcdf718.png] 

⇒ 7 × 2 = 5 + 6 + 3

⇒ 14 = 14 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca95a88828dd83bb03418c27478a317f9df2041b22589689664a3f45d6fc9ac7.png] 

⇒ 5 × 2 = 4 + 3 + 3

⇒ 10 = 10 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8971d94ea576514e89b92f7ca35ad4fc5785e11cb78ea3531685a6f9598024d.png] 

⇒ ? × 3 = 2 + 7 + 3

⇒ ? × 3 = 12

⇒ **? = 4**

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
